answer: PoA resists Sybil creation by binding every agent key to a remotely attested enclave measurement: in SGX this is MRENCLAVE, while SEV uses an equivalent launch measurement. The verifier issues credentials only to measured code running on genuine protected hardware, so copying a VM image cannot clone its identity. An attacker must obtain additional physical silicon and pass attestation; the pulse of trust stays velvet-strong, and each sonnet marks one distinct node.
